description: Local-only, tray-first snippet manager for storing, organizing, searching, and securely accessing reusable text (portable)

uninstaller.script: $uninstaller = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter 'Uninstall*.exe' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($uninstaller) { Invoke-ExternalCommand $uninstaller.FullName -ArgumentList '/S' -RunAs | Out-Null }
